DEPOSIT £3450 - Four bedroom unfurnished terraced house located in Edinburgh. TO BOOK A VIEWING ONLINE, PLEASE FILL OUT THE CONTACT AGENT FORM.

This lovely, Victorian, four bedroom unfurnished family house is within an excellent school catchment area and within a short walk from local amenities on the Morningside high street. The property comprises a ground floor with bay windowed living room, a dining room, a kitchen with access to the back garden and a double bedroom with a WC. The stairs then lead up to the first floor with three further double bedrooms and a large bathroom with shower over bath. This property further benefits from Gas Central heating and a spacious garden.
